payload.body_you: Saturn in Aries puts pressure on going first and going alone. You may take over because discussion feels too slow, decide for everyone, or leave the group the moment cooperation becomes frustrating. Some groups deserve to lose your labor. Others need you to participate without running the whole room. Community is not where you do all the carrying and call it belonging.

Some groups deserve to lose their labor; others need them to participate without running the whole room. Community is not where they do all the carrying and call it belonging.
